'''Alis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working as a wedding planner. Alis was an old friend of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] and circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Wren hired Alis to organize the senator's wedding to the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jarid DeBell]].
